tests.name: Documentation and traceability
tests.setup: review design revision, module UID, BOM, wiring and calibration documents
tests.pass_criteria: all items revision-bound; no missing safety-critical interface

tests.name: Port identification and misconnection resistance
tests.setup: try plausible wrong connections without fluid introduction
tests.pass_criteria: feed/product/reject/drain ports cannot be confused or casually misconnected

tests.name: Static leak integrity
tests.setup: test isolated water-containing assemblies within approved component pressure limits
tests.pass_criteria: no visible leak or pressure loss beyond specified test uncertainty

tests.name: Instrument identity and calibration
tests.setup: verify each instrument UID, range, capability, calibration validity, timebase and uncertainty
tests.pass_criteria: Mycelix admits each channel for its stated measurand/use

tests.name: Water-path reconciliation
tests.setup: run known metered volumes through each zone including reject and overflow
tests.pass_criteria: one-water balance residual within predeclared combined measurement uncertainty

tests.name: Feed identity and source exclusion
tests.setup: separate batches from each permitted source and one deliberately incompatible challenge
tests.pass_criteria: source identities preserved; incompatible challenge isolated and diverted

tests.name: Equalisation over-age and high-high
tests.setup: seed maximum age and independent high-high trip
tests.pass_criteria: feed stops and batch routes only to authorized waste

tests.name: Pump faults
tests.setup: per manufacturer-approved safe test method, seed low level and blocked discharge
tests.pass_criteria: pump de-energizes/isolation occurs without unsafe pressure or siphon

tests.name: Treatment process challenge
tests.setup: run low/median/high feed challenge composites within approved laboratory plan
tests.pass_criteria: all outputs independently sampled; report pass/fail against intended-use assessment; no performance assumption

tests.name: Barrier unavailable
tests.setup: seed loss of UV dose evidence or module fault
tests.pass_criteria: quarantine or divert; zero released fixture volume during fault window

tests.name: Quality evidence invalid
tests.setup: seed stale, missing, mismatched and conflicting batch/sample evidence

tests.name: Power interruption and recovery
tests.setup: remove power during feed, treatment, quarantine and idle states
tests.pass_criteria: safe isolation during outage; no automatic release on restart; post-fault requalification required

tests.name: Residual handling
tests.setup: meter screenings, sediment, reject, backwash, cleaning and failed-batch streams
tests.pass_criteria: all flows accounted and destination documented; no unqualified reuse/recovery credit

tests.name: Maintenance and changeover
tests.setup: trained technician removes/reinstalls cassette and carries out defined service tasks
tests.pass_criteria: no unsafe exposure, no fluid cross-connection, all work and downtime measured

tests.name: Post-storage end-use sample
tests.setup: sample accepted-water tank outlet after controlled storage intervals
tests.pass_criteria: independent intended-use quality assessment controls release; tank age and turnover in scope

tests.name: Cross-connection review
tests.setup: independent plumbing professional inspection and approved cross-connection test
tests.pass_criteria: no direct potable/non-potable cross-connection; approved air gap/backflow arrangement where applicable

release_gate: No occupied installation or procurement. A0 only advances after formal design, HAZOP, plumbing/electrical/water-quality review and approved test procedures.
